## Findings

### N. <Short title>

**Severity:** High / Medium / Low, and what it cost (time, a defect, a near-miss).

What happened, in the order it happened.

*Evidence:* commands run, output seen, IDs (`FND-`, `DEF-`, `VAL-`), timestamps.

*Shipped:* what changed as a result, and where. If nothing changed, say why and who owns it.
If a decision is load-bearing (undoing it reintroduces the bug), say so explicitly here.

## What the run confirmed was working

The parts not to touch. A retrospective that only lists problems invites someone to "improve"
something that was already right.
